answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the opal checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The canyon graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the timber audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 9 keys loses far more than 9 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
